# kattle Provider

Writes kattle `Cluster` objects to the kattle API server and shows the Airdrop plan of each layer in `terraform plan`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The CI template sets KATTLE_ADDR, KATTLE_TOKEN and, only in merge request plan jobs, KATTLE_PLAN_PREVIEW=true.
provider "kattle" {}

# Values in the provider block take precedence over the environment variables.
provider "kattle" {
  alias        = "explicit"
  address      = "https://kattle-dev.pubg.io"
  plan_preview = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) URL of the kattle API server. Defaults to the `KATTLE_ADDR` environment variable. One of them is required.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification.
- `plan_preview` (Boolean) Run an Airdrop plan through kattle `clusters/plan` during `terraform plan` when a `kattle_cluster` spec changes, and show the result in `layer_plans`. Each preview starts one Airdrop plan run. `terraform apply` plans again while applying and starts another run, so turn it on only in jobs that run `terraform plan` without applying, such as merge request plan jobs. Defaults to the `KATTLE_PLAN_PREVIEW` environment variable (`true` or `false`), and to `false` when it is not set.
- `plan_timeout` (String) How long `terraform plan` waits for a preview, as a Go duration such as `45m`. Defaults to `30m`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the kattle API server. Defaults to the `KATTLE_TOKEN` environment variable.
